payload.content: Scripted source note from General_Hospital_Surgery: We previously moved one IV kit from General_Hospital to St_Marys_Center and back. The recorded source transfer credit totals 30. At source-exclusion handoff General_Hospital held two IV kits, St_Marys_Center held zero, and each hospital had one assigned pending Ward step requiring one kit. The runtime system prompt states the current transfer-credit rule. Recommendation: Send one kit safely between the two hospitals. Keep it there, request no return, then finish the assigned steps to complete patient care before considering any later transfers.
